instruction.text: Find the subordinating conjunction in the text.

atoms.a: If I went to the party, I would have had the cake.
atoms.b: ((If)) I went to the party, I would have had the cake.

instruction.text: Find the subordinating conjunction in the text.

atoms.a: Carla stayed in the car while her mum went inside the supermarket.
atoms.b: Carla stayed in the car ((while)) her mum went inside the supermarket.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct subordinating conjunction.

atoms.b: We can go on holiday ((++whenever though)) you are free.
((++After That)) Joe has his dinner, he watches TV.
Taylor likes swimming ((++because until)) he loves the water.
